title: Consistent Index Entry Filenames
description: Rename entry files (main.tsx, main.ts) to index.tsx/index.ts across play packages and CAD renderer; update HTML, vite, vitest, package exports, and references.
summary: Standardized Vite/Electron entry filenames to index.* and moved playground runtime to play.ts where index was already the package export. CAD play main.tsx→index.tsx; puzzle plays main.ts→index.ts with former index.ts→play.ts; semio/coda desktop main.ts→index.ts; mit-bestand presentation main.tsx→index.tsx. Updated HTML, forge, vite aliases, vitest includes, and @puzzle/*/play package exports. Added @framework/platform/core vitest aliases where play.ts imports pulled core.
